description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, providing REST API endpoints for managing employee data. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting employee records, along with validation and permission checks. The class uses traits for employee service and user role management, and it defines OpenAPI annotations for documentation purposes.

classes.name: EmployeeAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for employee data management in the OrangeHRM system, including CRUD operations, validation, permission checks, and OpenAPI documentation.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee's details based on employee number, returning either default or detailed model.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring employee number access and optional model parameter.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines and returns the appropriate model class based on query parameter (default or detailed).

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees with filtering, sorting, and pagination options, returning a collection of employee models.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
